app.name: APRS Tracks
app.description: Private aprs-android location history, track statistics, and maps
auth.loginHelp: Review your location history, tracks, and maps.
auth.createHelp: The first account is the only user of this service. Create it to connect your phone.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters and at most 72 bytes. Some characters use multiple bytes.
app.subtitle: Your locations and journeys
tracks.rule: Each recording session forms one track, including stops and gaps.
tracks.failed: Could not load tracks. Please try again.
tracks.empty: No tracks in this date range
tracks.emptyHelp: Try another date range, or register your phone token in upload settings.
map.title: Track map
tracks.select: Select a track to view details
tracks.footer: Distance is calculated from GPS fixes and may be affected by GPS drift.
tokens.title: Upload tokens
tokens.help: Copy the token from Settings → Webhook in aprs-android and register it here. Only registered tokens can upload locations.
tokens.hashHelp: Only a hash is stored; the full token cannot be viewed after saving. If you refresh it on your phone, remove the old entry and register the new value.
tokens.emptyHelp: Copy the token from your phone, then fill in the form above.
success.tokenAdded: Token registered. You can now enable the webhook on your phone.
success.tokenDeleted: Token deleted. Existing location history has been kept.
error.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
error.invalidRange: Select valid dates. The end date must not be before the start date.
error.network: Cannot connect to the service. Check your network and try again.
error.requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
error.mapResources: Map resources could not load. Check your network and retry. Tracks and statistics are still available.
error.mapTimeout: Map loading timed out. Check your network and try again.
error.mapBrowser: This browser could not load the map. Try a browser that supports WebGL.
error.json: Invalid JSON or request too large.
error.origin: Request origin does not match. Check PUBLIC_URL.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
error.credentialsFormat: Use a username of 1–64 characters and a password of 12–72 bytes.
error.alreadyRegistered: The only account is already registered. Please sign in.
error.logout: Could not sign out. Please try again.
error.tokenFormat: The token must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; notes can contain up to 128 characters.

error.noteLength: Notes can contain up to 128 characters.
error.save: Could not save. Please try again.
error.tokenMissing: Token not found. Refresh the page.
error.location: Location fields are missing or out of range.
error.sessionID: session_id must be a canonical lowercase UUID v4.
error.uploadUnauthorized: The upload token is not registered or has been deleted.
error.toDate: The end date must not be before the start date.
error.trackChanged: This track has changed. Refresh the list.
